d.s: Sika SealTape F is an elastic system component which is used in combination with Sikawaterproofing products. It reduces the risk of leaks through potential cracking locations at wall corners, floor-to-wall connections, pipe entries etc.
a: Waterproof and watertight suitable for use in tiled pools and spas
Good adhesion to Sika waterproofing products
us: Crack-bridging and waterproofing tape used in combination with Sika
waterproofing products for reducing the risk of leakage at locations at risk to cracking for:
Cold storage areas, car washes and catering kitchens
Swimming pools and water retaining structures in combination with ceramic coverings
Sika SealTape F can be used with the following suitable Sika waterproofing membranes

sec.t: Sealing layer | Thermoplastic elastomers (TPE) Fleece | Non woven Polypropylene
The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging
Not suitable for direct contact with solvent based sealants or adhesives
Longitudinal | ≥ 85 N / 15 mm Lateral | ≥ 15 N / 15 mm
Chemically resistant against: Caustic Potash 3% Acetic Acid 5% Lactic Acid 5% Hydrochloric Acid 3% Sulphuric Acid 35% Citric Acid 10% Sea Water 20g/l sea salt

sec.l: Equivalent air layer thickness for water vapour

sec.t: All substrates must be stable, clean, dry, free of any loose or friable particles, contaminants such as dust, dirt, oil, wax polish, grease, old adhesive residue, cement laitance or efflorescence. Smooth surfaces must be roughened lightly and dust removed to improve adhesion. Surfaces shall be primed with a suitable primer prior to application. Refer to the selected Sika waterproofing membrane product data sheet for specific primer recomendations.
